desc: Combining the best features of Rhodesian and 1907 match-style slings, the RLS was created with Magpuls famous proprietary nylon mesh webbing and high-strength polymer hardware. At the core of the RLS lies Magpuls proprietary chafe-resistant 1 nylon mesh webbing. Its tubular construction eliminates harsh edges that can rub or snag and provides double layers of cushioned comfort against the end user while shouldered. The Magpul RLS features lightweight reinforced high-strength injection-molded polymer hardware, and a proprietary sling keeper that leaves no tails or loose straps, eliminating snag hazards and distractions.
